# stalwart_mta_route_local (Resource)

Defines a routing rule for outbound message delivery. Manages the Local Delivery variant.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Short identifier for the route

### Optional

- `description` (String) A short description of the route, which can be used to identify it in the list of routes

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
